the morphology of Au particles on CaO(001) can be tuned by doping the oxide lattice with Mo or Li.
doping of CaO films with Mo and Li can be used to tailor the morphology of Au particles deposited on the oxide.
the growth behavior of Au on CaO can be tuned by doping the oxide with Mo and Li.
